thread:
kevin: quick sync idea - fallback telemetry is spamming customers. propose: emit tiny "fallback_compact" events (reason enum + route + prompt_hash) and keep full traces sampled internally for audits.

nina: exposing enums might leak routing choices. need privacy review.

kevin: keep public payload minimal: reason only (latency_quota, model_error, overcapacity, policy_quarantine), no host ids. store raw traces internally with sampling.

sam: agreed. sketch compact event: {event_type: fallback_compact, customer_id, reason, route, prompt_hash, ts}. baseline sample 0.1%, auto-bump on spikes.

maria: Console UX: top-level "fallbacks by reason" chart + "view sampled traces" (operator-only). let customers opt into richer explanations via a consent toggle.

nina: for audits we need replayability. include prompt_hash + model_version so internal team can re-run when legally required.

kevin: API exposure: default keep `fallback_reason` out of responses. provide opt-in header X-Redwood-Fallback-Reason and Console consent.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-1428 for compact fallback telemetry; assigned @sam @maria.

kevin: next: sam -> schema PR, maria -> Console mock, nina -> privacy checklist. meet in 48h?

maria: yep.

sam: will open WIP PR tomorrow.

nina: adding security checklist to INF-1428.

kevin: great, keep public footprint tiny and audits intact.
